source: Scoring sheet for evaluating a stretch for tactical urbanism - GIZ/MoHUA Tactical Urbanism Guidebook (2020), Stage 1 Site selection

criteria.question: What are the building uses along the stretch?
criteria.finding: Mixed: shops and eateries along all three sides, St John's Medical College Hospital facing Sarjapura Road (C–A), a school, mosques and temples near Madiwala, public buildings (IIA, BBMP Madiwala office, CPWD) and Madiwala Park. Religious buildings count as acceptable.

criteria.question: What is the street network type of the chosen stretch?
criteria.finding: A loop: 100 Ft Road (A–B), Hosur Road (B–C) and Sarjapura Road (C–A), about 1.8 km around — the guidebook's first criterion ('Loops are good').

criteria.question: Does the stretch have an intersection?
criteria.finding: Yes — three signalised junctions: Water Tank (A), Madiwala underpass (B) and St John's (C).

criteria.question: Is the carriageway surface even (no potholes, bumps, manholes off grade)?
criteria.finding: OSM records an asphalt surface; condition unknown.

criteria.question: Is there ongoing construction activity along the street?
criteria.finding: Yes. The Ejipura flyover's ramp wall runs down the middle of 100 Ft Road (A–B) from 45 to 225 m. B-SMILE's elevated-corridor contract (tender, Oct 2026) adds viaducts over A–B, an elevated rotary at Madiwala junction (B), and names St John's junction (C) in its scope; construction 2026–28.
criteria.source: B-SMILE contract Schedules A & B; OSM; satellite imagery

criteria.question: What is the condition of the road shoulder?
criteria.finding: Covered RCC drains on both sides of 100 Ft Road (A–B) per the contract survey; unknown on Hosur Road and Sarjapura Road.
criteria.source: B-SMILE contract, Schedule A inventory (A–B only)

criteria.question: Is there a sidewalk along the stretch?
criteria.finding: Only 100 Ft Road (A–B) has survey data: footpaths 1.0–3.8 m wide, none on either side at 200 m, mostly below the 2.5 m IRC standard. Hosur Road (B–C) and Sarjapura Road (C–A) are not surveyed.
criteria.source: B-SMILE contract, Schedule A inventory (A–B only) — walk all three sides

criteria.question: If a sidewalk is present, what is the height of the kerb?
criteria.finding: Favourable at 150 mm or less. Not recorded in the contract inventory; OSM has kerb data only at Junction A.

criteria.question: Are there any obstacles along the pedestrian zone?
criteria.finding: Transformers, poles, bins, trenches - needs the walk.

criteria.question: Is there a fixed railing along the pedestrian zone?
criteria.finding: Not mapped; check on the walk.

criteria.question: Are there activity hotspots (ATM, tea shop, eatery, bus stop, vendors)?
criteria.finding: Yes: St John's Hospital and its KSRTC bus stand at junction C, Madivala Masjid and Koramangala Water Tank bus stops, Indira Canteen, Madiwala Park, eateries and private inter-city bus operators near Madiwala. Vendors still to be recorded on the walk.

criteria.question: Is there a visible conflict between vehicular and pedestrian flow?
criteria.finding: Likely: no mid-block crossing on any side — 455 m on A–B, 643 m on B–C, 663 m on C–A — past bus stops, a hospital, a mosque and a school. Observe at peak hour.
